defaultOptionValue: {{ (qListFacilitators.data || []).some(practitioner => practitioner.member_id === appsmith.store.facilitator_id) && (qMemberFacilitators.data || []).some(assignment => assignment.member_id === selMember.selectedOptionValue && assignment.facilitator_id === appsmith.store.facilitator_id && assignment.status === "active") ? appsmith.store.facilitator_id : "" }}
isVisible: {{ ((qPageAccess.data?.[0]?.can_member_functions === true && String(qPageAccess.data?.[0]?.email || '').trim().toLowerCase() === String(appsmith.user?.email || '').trim().toLowerCase()) && (true)) && (qPageAccess.data?.[0]?.is_document_reviewer === true || qPageAccess.data?.[0]?.is_practitioner === true) }}
sourceData: {{ (qListFacilitators.data || []).filter(practitioner => (qMemberFacilitators.data || []).some(assignment => assignment.member_id === selMember.selectedOptionValue && assignment.facilitator_id === practitioner.member_id && assignment.status === "active")).slice().sort((a, b) => `${a.last_name || ''} ${a.first_name || ''}`.localeCompare(`${b.last_name || ''} ${b.first_name || ''}`)).map(i => ({ label: `${i.first_name || ''} ${i.last_name || ''}`.trim(), value: i.member_id })) }}
